# To Reproduce
Add steps to reproduce the issue here, along with the distro details.

## Tegra Demo Distro

If possible please reproduce with [tegra-demo-distro](https://github.com/OE4T/tegra-demo-distro) and
specify the branch used.  A minimal reproducible fork is greatly appreciated.

When reproducing on tegra-demo-distro please provide:
1. Branch 'insert branch here'
2. `MACHINE` 'insert tegra MACHINE here'
3. Target image 'insert image type'

## Custom Distro/Layer Setup

When reproducing on a custom distro or layer setup please provide these details:
1. Branch 'insert branch here'
2. `MACHINE` based on 'insert tegra MACHINE here'
3. `PREFERRED_PROVIDER_virtual/kernel` setting.
4. Any other relevant layer customization details
